subject: SIG / CAIQ sync: scheduling, artifacts, and next steps
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@nimbleforge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@nimbleforge.com>, NimbleForge Security Team <security@nimbleforge.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake & scheduling - quick intro

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're evaluating Redwood for inference across a couple of regulated workloads and would like to run through a SIG/CAIQ intake next week. Primary goals: scope CAIQ coverage, confirm log retention/access, and identify owners for evidence handoff.

Availability on our side: Tue/Wed (Jun 16–17) between 10:00-14:00 PT. Can you propose a 45-min slot and share an initial artifact checklist?

Attaching a draft of our existing control matrix so you can see the gap areas.

Regards,
Aisha Malik
Head of Information Security
NimbleForge
(attachment: nimbleforge-sig-draft-answers.xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@nimbleforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake & scheduling - quick intro

Hi Aisha — thanks for reaching out and for the matrix. We can run a SIG/CAIQ sync and cover the items you listed. Proposed slot: Tue, Jun 16 at 11:00 PT for 45 minutes. If that works we’ll send a calendar invite.

For the call:
- I'll lead the CAIQ mapping and scope discussion.
- Marissa (Customer Solutions) will cover evidence handoff and sample pulls.
- Ben (Platform PM) will be on for architecture and logging details.

Pre-call asks (short):
1) Confirm the list of systems you want in scope (API, embeddings, private deployment).
2) Share any prefilled CAIQ sections you can (I grabbed the workbook).
3) If you need log samples, tell us the time window and retention expectations.

We can also provide the Redwood CAIQ baseline and a short note on our logs export/playbook.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Devon Park <devon.park@nimbleforge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@nimbleforge.com>, NimbleForge Security Team <security@nimbleforge.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 07:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake & scheduling - quick intro

Karthik — Tue 11:00 PT works for us. Calendar request received.

Two quick notes to cover on the call:
- We need clarity on tenant-level log access for dedicated vs hosted modes.
- We may request an encrypted log delivery to our S3; want to know the format and timeline.

I'll add a short doc in the shared Drive with sample retention policy requirements.

Thanks,
Devon
Engineering Lead, Compliance
NimbleForge

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@nimbleforge.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@nimbleforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Notes & action items from SIG/CAIQ sync (Jun 16)

Thanks again for taking the time today — summary and agreed actions below.

Meeting notes (45m):
- Attendees: Aisha, Devon (NimbleForge); Karthik, Marissa, Ben, Jonas (Redwood).
- Scope: CAIQ mapping for Redwood Hosted & Dedicated modes; candidate scope: API + embeddings + storage-backed model artifacts.
- Logs: Redwood supports tenant-level log exports for Dedicated and scoped log access for Hosted. We demonstrated the exports runbook (see recording).
- Evidence owners: Marissa will be primary contact for evidence transfer; Jonas will provide architecture diagrams and encryption details.

Agreed action items:
1) Redwood to share CAIQ baseline + prefilled answers for control families (Due: Jun 18) — owner: Karthik.
2) Marissa to create an evidence handoff checklist and S3 presigned-upload instructions (Due: Jun 19) — owner: Marissa.
3) Jonas to export a network architecture PNG and encryption summary (Due: Jun 18) — owner: Jonas (attachment: network-architecture.png).
4) NimbleForge to flag any in-scope systems and provide desired retention windows (Due: Jun 19) — owner: Aisha/Devon.

Reference links: call recording (internal), shared Drive with draft answers: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cNimbleForgeSIG

If anything above is off, let me know and I’ll update.

Regards,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@nimbleforge.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@nimbleforge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notes & action items from SIG/CAIQ sync (Jun 16)

Hi Aisha / Devon — attaching the evidence handoff checklist and a short runbook for presigned uploads. A couple items to confirm:
- Preferred archive format for logs (gzip JSONL vs raw syslog).
- Whether NimbleForge needs live push (TLS) or periodic presigned uploads.

Attachments: nimbleforge-evidence-checklist.pdf (generated), network-architecture.png (from Jonas)

Next steps: once you confirm retention and delivery method we’ll stage a test transfer (non-prod) and share a successful sample.

Best,
Marissa
Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachments: nimbleforge-evidence-checklist.pdf, network-architecture.png)
